subject: EOQ conversion catalyst — proposed credit offer for GammaApps
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.inference>
To: Riley Shaw <riley.shaw@gammaapps.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.inference, marissa_cole@redwood.inference
Date: 2026-03-25T10:14:00-07:00
Subject: EOQ conversion catalyst — proposed credit offer for GammaApps

Hi Riley —

Quick follow-up after our demo last week. GammaApps is showing strong evaluation signals and I want to propose a targeted credit offer to remove procurement friction and accelerate the conversion before quarter end. Idea below — happy to adjust.

Proposal (short):
- One-time $25k service credit applied to first 3 months of committed Dedicated usage (applied as invoice credit).
- 90-day trial extension on the hosted plan with the same rate-limits and prefix caching enabled for the POC workloads.
- Additional onboarding hours (8h) with our Solutions Engineer to expedite production tests.

Why this helps: reduces procurement objections around first-month spend, gives GammaApps runway to validate latency/throughput at scale, and creates a clear timeline for a closed-won before 2026-03-31.

I attached a short one-pager and a usage snapshot from their POC for context. If you and procurement are aligned I can put together a brief MOU and get finance sign-off.

Next steps: let me know if this is acceptable and whether procurement would need any alternate billing terms.

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0198

Attachments: eoq_conversion_catalyst_proposal_stephanie.pdf, gammaapps_usage_snapshot_q1.csv

From: Riley Shaw <riley.shaw@gammaapps.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-03-25T12:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: EOQ conversion catalyst — proposed credit offer for GammaApps

Hi Stephanie —

Thanks for the clear proposal. This could unblock procurement but I need to confirm two things with my CFO: 1) whether a credit applied against the first invoices is acceptable, and 2) if the 90-day extension needs a formal amendment.

Also, can you clarify any T&Cs on data retention/privacy tied to the trial extension? We operate in a regulated vertical and need to ensure no changes to retention policy.

I'll aim to get back to you by Wednesday.

Best,
Riley
Head of Platform | GammaApps
riley.shaw@gammaapps.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.inference>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.inference
Date: 2026-03-26T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: RE: EOQ conversion catalyst — proposed credit offer for GammaApps

Stephanie —

I reviewed the numbers with finance. $25k as a one-time credit is within our deal-floor for mid-market POCs if we get a 12-month committed Dedicated conversion or a 6-month minimum committed MRR equivalent. We should document the acceptance criteria in the MOU: target TPS, latency SLOs, and a signed purchase order.

On the retention question: per product policy trial extensions don't change default data retention; for regulated accounts we can add the standard DPA addendum language. I'll have legal prepare a short clause to attach to the MOU.

If you want, I can draft the MOU template and route it to finance for expedited approval.

-Aditya
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.inference>
To: Riley Shaw <riley.shaw@gammaapps.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.inference, marissa_cole@redwood.inference, ben_carter@redwood.inference
Date: 2026-03-26T10:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: EOQ conversion catalyst — proposed credit offer for GammaApps

Riley —

Thanks — good to know on the CFO timing. Quick answers:
- Credit mechanics: invoice credit applied to first 3 invoices; finance is flexible on net-terms but prefers a PO so we can process the credit against committed capacity.
- Trial extension: no change to retention defaults. We'll attach our DPA snippet for regulated workloads (legal review noted by Aditya).

If your CFO wants tighter billing terms we can discuss shifting to a rebate model tied to metered usage instead of invoice credits.

I'll pause on drafting the MOU until I hear back from you; if procurement needs, we can do a short 1-page MOU and an addendum with the technical acceptance criteria.

Best,
Stephanie

From: Procurement <procurement@gammaapps.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.inference>, Riley Shaw <riley.shaw@gammaapps.com>
Date: 2026-03-29T08:55:00-07:00
Subject: Re: EOQ conversion catalyst — proposed credit offer for GammaApps

Hi Stephanie —

We can accept a one-time invoice credit; prefer it as a credit applied against the first invoice with 30-day payment terms. We'll need a short MOU and an invoice-level schedule showing the credit application. Please also include the DPA excerpt Riley requested.

If you can get legal/finance notes in the MOU by EOD Tuesday (2026-03-30) we'll route internally and try to sign the same week.

Thanks,
GammaApps Procurement Team

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.inference>, aditya_rao@redwood.inference, ben_carter@redwood.inference
Date: 2026-03-30T11:12:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: EOQ conversion catalyst — proposed credit offer for GammaApps

FYI — Looping finance/legal for sign-off. Stephanie: give me the one-pager and I will escalate if we need an exception beyond the $25k. Also confirm that the 8h SE hours are billable as part of onboarding (we typically treat those as included in the credit).

-M

On Tue, Mar 30, 2026 at 08:07 AM Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.inference> wrote:
> Steph — drafting MOU now. Confirmed: SE hours will be rolled into the credit scope (i.e., part of the $25k).
> 
> Routing to finance to lock payment mechanics.
> 
> -A

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.inference>
To: Riley Shaw <riley.shaw@gammaapps.com>, Procurement <procurement@gammaapps.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.inference, marissa_cole@redwood.inference, ben_carter@redwood.inference
Date: 2026-03-31T17:02:00-07:00
Subject: Final — EOQ credit MOU & DocuSign link

Riley / Procurement —

Attached is the 1-page MOU and the short promo terms addendum. Key items: $25,000 invoice credit applied across the first three invoices (line-item credit), 90-day trial extension, and onboarding (8 hours) included in the credit. The DPA excerpt is appended.

DocuSign link: https://docusign.example.com/envelope/0a1b2c3d
HubSpot: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/1002345

Please countersign and send PO to billing@redwood.inference so finance can process the credit as soon as we receive the signed MOU. If you prefer a rebate instead of invoice credit, let me know and we'll route an alternate schedule.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to closing this before EOD Wednesday.

Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.inference
